summary: Factor K de Condición General tested end-to-end. Backend: new test_factor_k.py (24 tests) + regression test_factor_f/test_signature/test_case_sheet = 62/62 PASS. kvolume 80kg/175cm/male/avg K .135 F 1.093 -> 8.93 L; K bounds 0.10/0.18 inclusive, 0.09/0.19/0.5/'abc'/null/missing -> 400; injection k_factor 0.135 -> recommended_l 8.17 (8.93 with F 1.093), results.k_factor present only when sent, invalid K -> 400; case_sheet.condicion_general persists; POST /cases/{id}/calculations kvolume label 'Volumen por Factor K'; PDF shows 'Condicion general (Factor K)' 'Caso rutinario - K 0.12-0.15 L/kg (prom. 0.135)'. Frontend (375x667): Hoja del caso kcond-<key> single-select + tap-again deselect works in /case/sheet and /case/new, saved correctly; case hub Cálculos tab shows open-calc-kvolume -> /calculator/kvolume?caseId=; sheet prefill works (kcond-calc-rutinario active, K 0.135, Factor F tab preselected 1.093, weight 80/height 175); K 0.25 shows k-factor-warning and blocks Calcular (no API call, toast); result 8.93 L and save works (persisted, navigates back to case); comma decimal '0,15' accepted; wizard step 3 shows wiz-recommended-k 'recomendado K×MM×F 8.93 L' and saves. 'Vello Facial' label present. No deprecated expo packages detected. Only minor UX notes.

ui_bugs.issue: After manually editing K (e.g. 0.15 while 'Cuerpo pequeño' 0.10-0.12 chip is selected) the chip stays highlighted, so the UI shows a condition inconsistent with the applied K. Consider deselecting chip when K is outside the selected condition's range, or showing 'personalizado'.

issues: Result grid shows raw backend keys (volume_l, gallons, k_factor, factor_f, lbm_kg, lbm_method, case_type) instead of Spanish labels (same pre-existing pattern as other calculators).

design_issues.screen: Hoja del caso - Condición general (Factor K)
issues: Selected row background (rgb 226,232,240) is barely distinguishable from unselected (rgb 241,245,249); selection relies mostly on the radio icon. Consider a stronger active border/background.

action_items: (LOW) KFactorPicker: reflect manual K edits in chip selection (deselect or mark custom when outside range).
(LOW) Localize result keys in /calculator/[type] result grid.
(LOW) Strengthen active style of kcond-<key> rows in CaseSheetForm.
(INFO) Old auth-era tests in test_preservia_api.py / test_pdf_publish.py / test_no_auth_flow.py still fail (15) because auth was removed and LBM formula changed; consider deleting/updating them.
critical_code_review_comments: calculator/[type].tsx save() re-builds inputs at save time rather than reusing the inputs that produced the displayed result; safe today because every input change resets result (disabling save), but fragile.
Wizard always sends sheet K avg (no way to override K in wizard) - acceptable per spec.
Backend sheet endpoint does not validate condicion_general key (any string saved); PDF/frontend ignore unknown keys so harmless.
Expo log reports expo@54.0.35 (expected ~54.0.37) - request mentions SDK 58 but project is on SDK 54; minor patch-version mismatch warnings only.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_KUI, TEST_KUI_SHEET, TEST_NewK cases for UI tests - all deleted afterwards; pytest fixtures delete their own cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Backend URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Factor K tests in test_factor_k.py. LBM avg for 80kg/175cm male = 60.505 kg.
